allow: PowerShell($json = Get-Content ~/.claude.json | ConvertFrom-Json; $projectKey = "E:/claude_code/workspaces/claude-code-mastery"; if \($json.projects.$projectKey\) { $json.projects.$projectKey.mcpServers | ConvertTo-Json } else { Write-Output "No project entry" })

PowerShell(Get-ChildItem ~/.claude/skills/synced -Directory | ForEach-Object { $skillPath = $_.FullName; Get-ChildItem $skillPath -Filter "SKILL.md" -Recurse | ForEach-Object { Write-Output \("`n" + $skillPath.Split\('\\'\)[-1] + ":`n" + \(Get-Content $_.FullName | Select-Object -First 10\)\) } })
PowerShell($json = Get-Content ~/.claude/settings.json | ConvertFrom-Json; if \($json.permissions\) { $json.permissions | ConvertTo-Json } else { Write-Output "No permissions section" })
